Anshula Kapoor’s Mumbai Wedding: What a One-Venue Celebration Actually Costs

August 07, 2026 • Viraaya Weddings Team

Arjun Kapoor’s sister, Anshula Kapoor, married Rohan Thakkar on July 6, 2026, and the wedding has been all over social media ever since. At Viraaya Weddings, what stood out to us wasn’t the star power (although we definitely enjoyed it!). It was the format of the wedding: an intimate, one-day ceremony blending two communities’ traditions, hosted entirely at Taj Lands End in Mumbai, followed by a larger, star-studded reception the next day.

That’s a destination wedding format more couples are embracing: one venue, everything under a single roof fewer days, one venue and no city-hopping. Here’s a closer look at what a wedding like Anshula Kapoor’s could cost and what makes the one-venue approach so appealing.

 

What Does a Wedding Like Anshula Kapoor’s Typically Cost?

The family hasn’t publicly disclosed the cost of the wedding. However, based on our experience with similar five-star weddings in Mumbai, a realistic estimate for accommodation and meals can be calculated.

Room rates at a coastal five-star property such as Taj Lands End, Mumbai, usually range from INR 15,000 to INR 20,000 per night on double occupancy, while per-person meal costs fall between INR 5,000 and INR 6,500 depending on the menu and service style.

What Determines the Cost of a One-Venue Wedding?

Couples often assume a single-venue wedding is automatically cheaper because there’s no need to switch between locations. That’s true up to a point, but a few factors still move the number:

  • Guest Count: The biggest lever. Going from 150 to 250 guests can shift catering and accommodation costs by lakhs.
  • Number of Functions in One Day: Anshula Kapoor’s wedding to Rohan Thakkar blended traditions from two communities into a single ceremony, which is efficient, but the décor and catering still need to account for each ritual.
  • Venue Category: A coastal five-star property like Taj Lands End sits at a premium, reflected in the per-night and per-plate rates.
  • A coastal five-star property like Taj Lands End sits at a premium versus a standard banquet hall, reflected in the per-night and per-plate rates.
  • Reception Scale: Even at the same property, a larger reception hosted on a separate day (as Anshula and Rohan did at Taj Lands End) adds its own catering, décor and entertainment costs on top of the wedding day itself.

 

Why Couples Are Choosing the One-Venue Wedding Format

Anshula Kapoor’s wedding is a good real-world example of why this format is gaining ground:

  • No shuttling guests across the city. Everyone’s already there for the next function, which cuts down on lost time and transport costs.
  • Easier vendor coordination. One venue means one team manages décor, catering and logistics throughout the day instead of juggling multiple properties.
  • Personal touches stand out more. Anshula's bridal look featured her late mother’s 42-year-old heirloom dupatta, and it was the detail people remembered most, not the scale of the event. A one-venue format gives these moments room to land.
  • A single, unified guest experience. With everyone in one place, guests move naturally from one function to the next instead of losing time re-arriving, re-dressing or re-orienting at a new venue each day.

 

How Viraaya Weddings Helps You Plan a Wedding Like This

Most couples asking about the Anshula Kapoor wedding cost aren’t chasing gossip. They’re really asking, “What would this cost me?” That’s where Viraaya Weddings comes in.
